description: This file defines models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for handling Cboe Index Constituents data, including data transformation and API request logic.

classes.name: CboeIndexConstituentsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching Cboe index constituents, with a default symbol set to 'BUK100P'.

classes.name: CboeIndexConstituentsData
classes.description: Represents the data for Cboe index constituents, including price, volume, and timestamp information, with data validation and aliasing.

classes.name: CboeIndexConstituentsFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching, transformation, and API interaction for Cboe index constituents.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a CboeIndexConstituentsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from the Cboe API endpoint based on the query.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a list of CboeIndexConstituentsData objects, normalizing percentage values and cleaning the DataFrame.
